label: r2c1
name: Frames x 3 orders x DONE position
hypothesis: This extends the r1c2 window head to 48 options: 8 frames × 3 index orders (t-y-x, y-x-t, y-t-x) × DONE last or first. Each option gets its own map, and a ×5 softmax starting uniform picks one. If DONE is at index 0 or the type sits in the middle of the index, the agent cannot stop cleanly, which would explain zero training success. Refuted if both seeds score 0 on training and dev.
